message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑climate weather. The average daily high is around **68 °F (20 °C)**, while the average low dips to about **48 °F (9 °C)**. So the overall average temperature for the month hovers near **58 °F (14 °C)**. These figures can vary slightly year to year, but December is usually one of the cooler months in LA, though still relatively comfortable compared to many other U.S. cities.
